description: Search the official changelog of a coding-agent CLI for a flag, command or setting (e.g. '--full-auto', 'claude -p', 'permission mode'). Returns `known` (verified usage changes, incl. ones not in recent release notes) and `hits` (matching changelog entries, newest first; breaking=true marks removals, renames and default changes). Empty results mean no recorded change in the fetched history.
name: check_usage
title: Check a flag or command against recent changes
